doc.name: Capxule
doc.instructions: Capxule guided journeys: step-by-step journeys through one topic each, written from the creator's sources. Each step is composed here and returned as one beat (answer, statement, numbered options) for you to show the user. find_journey finds a journey for a topic; list_journey_categories and browse_journeys show what exists; open_journey starts or resumes one; take_journey_step sends the user's choice and returns the next step; get_journey_progress reports where the user is; create_takeaway makes a summary to keep; get_resume_link returns a link to continue later; restart_journey starts over only when the user asks. Show answer and every options[].text as given; statement may be reworded. Read each card's for and not_for to the user before opening a journey. If a step carries wall, tell the user wall.for_human; when it offers a link, share the link. Every error carries code, for_human, for_agent and next. At the first step, tell the user once that the answers come from Capxule's AI and not from a person (open_journey carries that sentence as notice.for_human). This service needs no personal information: do not ask the user for health, biometric, government ID, financial or payment details, email addresses or passwords, and do not pass such details in any argument. Documentation: https://capxule.ai/llms.txt. Topics covered: 412 guided journeys across 15 areas: Education (243, e.g. Master AP U.S. History: The Complete APUSH Exam…; Win More Financial Aid Support Before Enrollment), Career (45, e.g. Verify Remote Job Listings Before You Apply or…; Colorado Real Estate Broker License Exam), Culture (22, e.g. One Piece: The Grand Line Voyage — Complete Sto…; Mastering Speedrun Optimization Through Glitche…), Business (21, e.g. Mastering Email Sequences for Customer Recovery…; How to Navigate Budget Questions in Sales Disco…), Lifestyle (13, e.g. Choosing Childcare: Balancing Cost, Quality, an…; Home Solar Decisions, Done Right), Technology (13, e.g. The Age of AI: From Antiquity to Modern Age; AI Boom Economics: Profits, Compute Costs, and…), Psychology (12), Food (10), Fitness (8), Exam preparation (6), Science (5), Society (5), Creative (4), Applications and filings (3), History (2). The full list is the resource capxule://catalog.

tools.name: find_journey
tools.title: Find a guided journey
tools.description: Use when the user wants a guided, step-by-step journey on a topic, a skill or an exam. Searches the published journeys and returns up to three cards (id, title, summary, shape, languages, number of stops, estimated minutes, who it is for and not for, a premium flag, page_url). `in_progress: true` marks a journey this user already has open. When nothing matches, `alternatives` holds the three nearest journeys.

query.description: The topic, skill or exam to search for, in a few words. The topic only, no personal details.

locale.description: The user's locale (en, fr, es, ar).

tools.name: list_journey_categories
tools.title: List journey categories
tools.description: Use when the user asks what kinds of journeys are available. Returns each category slug, a readable label, the number of journeys in it and a few example titles.

tools.name: browse_journeys
tools.title: Browse journeys
tools.description: Use when the user wants to look through the journeys, optionally within one category (a slug from list_journey_categories). Returns a page of the same cards as find_journey, with the total and next_offset.

category.description: A category slug from list_journey_categories (e.g. education). Omit for every category.

offset.description: Start position; pass next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: open_journey
tools.title: Open a journey
tools.description: Use when the user chooses a journey to start or continue. Opens it, or resumes the user's session for it, and returns the session contract: `session`, the stop titles, the capabilities, the limits in turns and the first step. Calling it again for the same journey resumes the same session; it never resets progress.

capsule_id.description: The journey id from find_journey (uuid or short id). `welcome` opens the sandbox tour.

slug.description: The journey slug, when you hold that instead of the id.

locale.description: Preferred locale; the beat echoes the locale actually served.

goal.description: What the user wants from the journey, in a few words, if they said. No personal details.

tools.name: take_journey_step
tools.title: Take a journey step
tools.description: Use for every step after open_journey. Sends the user's choice and returns the next step: `answer`, `statement`, numbered `options` with ids, `media`, `progress` and `limits`. Send `pick` with an option id when the user chose an option or its number; otherwise send `say` with what the user said. `go` jumps to a stop from the contract; `drill` and `simulate` start practice on exam journeys; `exit` leaves practice. Supply a fresh `turn_id` per step; a repeat returns the stored step. If the step carries `wall`, tell the user `wall.for_human`.

session.description: The session handle from open_journey (starts with cxs_).

turn_id.description: Your idempotency id for this step (fresh per step).

option.description: An option id from the LAST beat.

said.description: What else the user said about this step, when they said more than the option. No personal details.

text.description: What the user said in reply to this step. No personal details.

node.description: A stop id from the contract's toc.

tools.name: get_journey_progress
tools.title: Get journey progress
tools.description: Use when the user asks where they are in a journey, how far they have come or how much is left. Returns the current stop, visited and remaining stops, percent done, practice stats, limits and a resume line.

session.description: The session handle from open_journey (starts with cxs_).

tools.name: create_takeaway
tools.title: Create a takeaway
tools.description: Use when the user asks for a summary to keep. Composes a markdown takeaway from this journey session: what the user asked, the key points and the stops visited. Available on connected accounts; otherwise returns not_available.

session.description: The session handle from open_journey (starts with cxs_).

template_id.description: Required for kind template: an id from capabilities.templates.

tools.name: get_resume_link
tools.title: Get a resume link
tools.description: Use when the user wants to continue the journey later, on the website or in another assistant. Returns a resume link and a short resume code for this session.

session.description: The session handle from open_journey (starts with cxs_).

tools.name: restart_journey
tools.title: Restart a journey
tools.description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to start a journey over, after confirming with them. Returns to the first step and clears the visited stops; turns already used stay used. Returns the same session contract as open_journey.

capsule_id.description: The journey id (uuid or short id).

slug.description: The journey slug, when you hold that instead of the id.

prompts.name: start_journey
prompts.title: Start a Capxule journey
prompts.description: How to run a Capxule guided journey for your user, plus the first call to make. Optional argument `capsule`: a capsule id or slug to open directly instead of searching.

arguments.name: capsule
arguments.description: A journey id or slug to open directly. Omit to search on the user's words.

resources.name: catalog
resources.title: Capxule journey catalog
resources.description: Every area the published guided journeys cover, with counts and example titles, and links to the full machine-readable catalog.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: The user's guided journey: a map of the stops explored, the current answer, and the options to tap next. Taps continue the same journey.
